name: hacker_news
archetype: Tech news aggregator and developer community link board
market: Global, technically sophisticated developers, startup founders, researchers
density: Ultra-minimal, information-dense in a deliberately text-only way. No images whatsoever except a tiny orange Y logo. Every line is a story. 30 stories fit above the fold. The density is achieved through radical text compression — no visual hierarchy, no cards, no images. Just numbered lines of text with metadata.
nav_style: Single orange top bar. Left: Y logo, 'Hacker News' text link, navigation links (new, past, comments, ask, show, jobs, submit). Right: login link. That's it. The entire navigation is one line of text.
commercial_model: Non-commercial, run by Y Combinator. No ads. No revenue. No popups. The only monetization is indirect: goodwill and talent pipeline for YC. Hiring posts appear in a separate jobs section.
color_palette: Hacker News orange (#FF6600) for the top bar and vote triangles. White (#FFFFFF) page background. Black (#000000) text. Dark grey (#828282) for subtext (points, author, time, comment count). Visited links in a slightly different shade. Minimal, functional, intentionally archaic.
typography: Verdana 10pt — intentionally stuck in the 2007 design era. No heading hierarchy — everything is the same size. The visual compression is extreme by modern standards. Comment indentation by reply depth creates the only visual structure.

pages.title: Front Page
pages.description: 30 numbered stories with title, domain in parens, upvote triangle, points, username, time, comment count. Top bar navigation. Pagination with 'More' link at bottom.

pages.title: New Stories
pages.description: Newest submissions sorted by time, not votes. Same layout as front page. These are unvetted — spam more common. Community self-moderation visible.

pages.title: Ask HN
pages.description: Community questions: 'Ask HN: What is everyone working on this month?' type posts. Higher text content ratio. Long discussion threads visible.

pages.title: Show HN
pages.description: Founders and developers showing what they built. 'Show HN: I made X using Y' format. Product launches, side projects, open source tools.

pages.title: Jobs
pages.description: YC company job postings. Minimal layout matching the rest. No images, no logo. Just company name, role, location, and 'remote ok' or 'on-site' indicator.
